title: Stock futures are little changed as traders brace for wholesale inflation report: Live updates
summary: Traders are closely monitoring the first of two inflation reports this week while oil prices continue to rise, potentially affecting market movement. The inflation data is crucial for investment decisions and Federal Reserve policy expectations.
content: The first of two inflation reports due this week is in focus as oil prices rise.

zh.title: 股票期货基本持平，交易员为批发价格通胀报告做准备：实时更新
zh.summary: 交易员密切关注本周两份通胀报告中的第一份，同时油价继续上升，可能影响市场走势。通胀数据对投资决策和美联储政策预期至关重要。

title: Trump promises $5,000 checks if Republicans win the midterms. He also teased tariff and ‘DOGE’ dividends last year that never came.
summary: At the GOP midterm convention, Trump promised $5,000 checks to households if Republicans win, though past promises of tariff dividends failed to materialize. The announcement comes as Republicans face expected losses in November due to voter dissatisfaction with inflation.
content: President Trump’s speech at his party’s midterm convention in Dallas comes as many analysts expect losses for Republicans in November’s elections due to voters’ frustrations with high prices.

zh.title: 特朗普承诺如果共和党赢得中期选举将发放5000美元支票。他去年还暗示关税和"DOGE"股息最终未兑现。
zh.summary: 在共和党中期选举大会上，特朗普承诺如果共和党获胜，将向家庭发放5000美元支票，尽管过去关于关税股息的承诺未能实现。这一宣布之际，共和党因选民对通胀的不满而面临11月的预期损失。

title: UBS CEO flags investor complacency as geopolitical and economic risks mount
summary: UBS's chief executive warned that investors are underestimating risks in an increasingly complex environment marked by multiple economic and geopolitical challenges. The warning signals growing concerns among financial leaders about market stability.
content: The UBS top boss cautioned that investors face an increasingly complicated environment given multiple headwinds.

zh.title: 瑞银集团首席执行官警示投资者自满情绪，地缘政治和经济风险加剧
zh.summary: 瑞银集团首席执行官警告投资者在经济和地缘政治挑战众多的日益复杂的环境中低估了风险。这一警告表明金融领袖对市场稳定性的担忧日益加剧。

title: Samsung works to draw iPhone users to its foldables even as Apple enters the market
summary: Samsung is aggressively targeting iPhone users to adopt its foldable phones as Apple prepares to enter the foldable market, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape. The move reflects the growing importance of foldable technology in the smartphone industry.
content: Samsung is drawing more iPhone users to its foldables as Apple’s rumored entry threatens to reshape the market.

zh.title: 三星致力于在苹果进入市场时吸引iPhone用户购买其可折叠手机
zh.summary: 随着苹果准备进入可折叠手机市场，三星积极瞄准iPhone用户采购其可折叠手机，可能重塑竞争格局。这一举措反映了可折叠技术在智能手机行业中日益增长的重要性。

title: Hunter Biden memecoin $LAPTOP loses 95% of market value just hours after launch
summary: A memecoin tied to Hunter Biden collapsed 95% in value shortly after its launch, signaling weak investor demand for memecoins despite recent bitcoin price increases. The crash highlights ongoing skepticism toward speculative digital assets.
content: Investor appetite for memecoins has clearly not recovered, even as bitcoin prices have crept higher.

zh.title: Hunter Biden相关代币$LAPTOP在上线数小时后价值下跌95%
zh.summary: 与Hunter Biden相关的代币在上线后不久价值暴跌95%，表明尽管比特币价格最近上涨，投资者对代币的需求仍然较弱。此次崩盘凸显了市场对投机性数字资产的持续怀疑。

title: Ant International partners with Visa, Mastercard on developing AI payments
summary: Visa, Mastercard, and Ant International are collaborating on universal standards for AI-powered payment systems, including methods to verify and monitor AI agent transactions. The partnership addresses the emerging need for infrastructure to support autonomous payment systems.
content: Visa, Mastercard and Ant International are working on common standards for AI-agent payments — including ways to verify and monitor their transactions.

zh.title: 蚂蚁国际与Visa、万事达卡合作开发AI支付系统
zh.summary: Visa、万事达卡和蚂蚁国际正在合作开发AI驱动的支付系统通用标准，包括验证和监控AI代理交易的方法。该合作伙伴关系解决了支持自主支付系统基础设施的新兴需求。

title: Inside India newsletter: India’s green push aims to boost energy security but exposes China dependency
summary: India's renewable energy expansion aims to achieve energy independence but reveals significant reliance on Chinese technology and materials. The tension highlights challenges developing nations face in balancing environmental goals with geopolitical dependencies.
content: India's ambition to create a self-reliant energy ecosystem by expanding its renewable energy footprint is facing a China problem.

zh.title: 印度内部通讯：印度的绿色能源推动旨在提升能源安全，但暴露了对中国的依赖
zh.summary: 印度的可再生能源扩张旨在实现能源独立，但揭示了对中国技术和材料的重大依赖。这种紧张局势突出了发展中国家在平衡环保目标与地缘政治依赖之间所面临的挑战。

title: Tax banks to give some households energy bill cut, unions tell Burnham
summary: The TUC is calling for a surcharge on banks to be reversed, proposing it would raise £9 billion over four years to fund energy bill relief for households. The proposal reflects growing pressure to address the cost-of-living crisis through targeted taxation.
content: The TUC says a bank surcharge should be reversed - and estimates it would raise £9bn over four years.

zh.title: 对银行征税为家庭提供能源账单削减，工会向伯纳姆提议
zh.summary: 英国贸易工会大会呼吁取消对银行的附加税，提议在四年内筹集90亿英镑为家庭提供能源账单救济。该提议反映了通过有针对性的税收来解决生活成本危机的越来越大的压力。
